book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakwalobholela bhantole Yecho, bhankenyule yato ya limbendela lya ndomondo.
Bhene akakomana ngondo bhajhakuhinga hingo jha mibha na kuwalikiya pamuto. Helahela bhajhakuwalikiya ngholole gwa unahota nkolongwa.
Bhajhakunyendelela palonge jhake na kunyambucha bhalongila, “Mbukwa, Munahota Nkolongwa jwa Akayahude!” Bhamatwila mbalamande jha umatama lapu.
Pilatu ngapitita panja kabhele na kwalobholela Akayahude, “Dolekeya, nipiya panja na umanyengane nikihwejhe cha kunhadabula mundo jhonjo.”
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakupita panja kongo ahwalite hingo jha mibha na ngholole gwa unahota nkolongwa. Pilatu ajhakwalobholela, “Munolekehe! Mundo jwenio ndi jhonjo!”

Akapiya matambiko na akalonda bha Nyumba jha Chapanga pibhammonita Yecho, bhajhakunonoha njobhelo bhalongila, “Mumambe panchalaba! Mumambe panchalaba!” Pilatu ajhakwalobholela, “Mtolangane mabhene mukamambe panchalaba, nenga nilihwe ndeka lyalemwite lilemo lyolyoha.”
Akayahude bhajhakunnyangula, “Twenga tubhii na lilaghalikilo, lilaghalikilo lyenio lilongela limpala akomwe, nhwalo jwenio alongila Mwana jwa Chapanga.”
Pilatu pajhohina lilobhe lyenio, ajhakujhoghopa hake.
Papa ngajhingila kabhele mu liboma lyake na kunkonya Yecho, “Bho, mwenga nhumi kojhe?” Nambo Yecho akajhangwii jhe.
Nambo, Pilatu ajhakunnobholela Yecho, “Bho, umeke maghonga kulonge na nenga? Umanyite ndeka nenga ngwete ukindendeke gwa kunyogholela amu kumamba panane jha nchalaba.”
Yecho ajhakunyangula, “Mwenga ukindendeke kunhadabuu nenga nhwalo ukindendeke gwenio mpatite na Chapanga. Jhola jwanetite kwino ndi jwabhii na uhakaho twe.”

Kubhoke peniya, Pilatu apaliya ndela jha kunnekekeya Yecho. Nambo Akayahude bhajhakutumbuu kuchobhela kanonoha bhalongila, “Anda munekikiye mundo jhonjo, mwenga makoche jhe jwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma! Mundo jhojhoha jwakitenda munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma!”
Bhahe, Pilatu pajhohina malobhe gheniya ajhakumpiya Yecho panja, peniya Pilatu ajhakutama pa kigoda cha luhadabulo pipikemwa “Lubhanja lwa maghanga.” Kiebulaniya bhikema Gabatha.
Pihikila chaa chita jha muhe, lichiko lya kulenganikiya Pachaka. Pilatu ajhakwalobholela Akayahude, “Ndi Munahota Nkolongwa gwino jhonjo!”

Nambo Akayahude bhajhakunonoha njobhelo bhalongila, “Mukome! Mukome! Mumambe panane jha nchalaba!” Pilatu ajhakwakonya, “Mipala nimambe munahota nkolongwa gwino?” Akapiya matambiko bhakolo bhajhakujhanguu, “Twenga tukwete jhe munahota nkolongwa jhonge nambo munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma!”

Peniya, Pilatu ajhakwakamuha Yecho mu mabhoko gha akakomana ngondo bhamambe panane jha nchalaba. Yecho bhamamba panchalaba Matei 27:32-44; Maluku 15:21-32; Luka 23:26-43 Peniya akakomana ngondo bhajhakuntola Yecho.
Yecho ajhakubhoka pa muche kongo agheghite nchalaba gwake, ade chehemo jhikemitwa “Libhonge lya Muto,” kwa Kiebulaniya bhikema Goligota.
Peniya ndi pibhamambita Yecho panchalaba, helahela bhakabhambitwe bhando bhange bhabhele, jhumo lubhoko lwalelo na jhonge lwa ngejha, na Yecho pakate.
Pilatu ajhakujhandika litangacho na kulibheka panane jha nchalaba gwa Yecho, “Yecho jwa ku Nachalete ndi Munahota Nkolongwa jwa Akayahude.”
Pala pibhammambita Yecho panchalaba pakibha pahina na muche. Bhahe, Akayahude bhamahele bhahwelita kuchoma majhandiko gha litangacho lyenio, na ghakajhandikwe kwa Kiebulaniya na Kilatine na Kigilike.
Bhahe, akapiya matambiko bhakolo bhajhakunnobholela Pilatu, “Nkotoka kujhandika naha, ‘Munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude,’ nambo jwenio alongila naha, ‘Nenga ndi Munahota Nkolongwa jwa Akayahude.’ ”
Pilatu ngalongila, “Ghunyandike, nihoto jhe kughalambula.”

Akakomana ngondo pubhajhomolila kummamba Yecho panane jha panchalaba, bhajhakutola ngobho yake na bhajhakuhibhaghana malundiko ncheche, kila lipungo kwa akakomana ngondo jhumo. Helahela bhajhakutola ade likanjo lyake na lyenio lyangachonwa, jhikalokwite kuhumii kunane ade pahe.

Akakomana ngondo bhajhakulongolelana, “Tukotoka kujhepula likanjo lende, nambo tuhenge kahumbuhumbu nnobhole tumanye nalibhaha lyaghane.” Itendika naha kupala ghatimile Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghighalongila,

content.text: nambo likanjo lyango bhajhakulitendela kahumbuumbu nnobhole.”

content: Naha ndi chibhakatenda bheniya akakomana ngondo.
Pahina jha pa nchalaba gwa Yecho bhakajhemite akamajhe mundo, majhe mundo Yecho na Maliya nhwana mundo Kiliopa na Maliya jwahumila ku kilambo cha ku Magidala.
Yecho pammonita majhe mundo na mmolwa gwake jhola jwapalita hake, ajhakunnobholela majhe mundo, “Majhe, jwenio ngoheno ndi mwana gwino.”
Peniya ajhakunnobholela mmolwa jhola, “Ngoheno, jwenio ndi majhe gwino.” Kuhumi peniya, mmolwa jwenio ajhakunghegha Maliya, ajhakutama nako kajhake.
Yecho ihwegha
Yecho akamanyite ghoha ghakamilike, Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghabhii telatela, Yecho ajhakulonge, “Nijhoha nyota.”

Pahina jhake pakibha na kilebhe chikitwelile divaye jhibhabha. Bhahe, akakomana ngondo bhajhakuchwiya mu lidodoke mu divaye jhibhabha jhela, na kuhomeka mulundwatwabhe lwa hichopo, nakumekela Yecho pannomo.
Bhahe, Yecho papekiwa divaye jhene jhibhabhite ajhakulonge, “Ghoha ghatimile!” Peniya ajhakujhinamicha muto gwake, na kuwegha.
Yecho bhanundukuu nkowa mu lubhaho

Lichiko lyenio likibha lichiko lya kukilenganikiya, na lichiko lilikengima likibha lichiko lya Kupomolela lya Akayahude. Nhwalo ghongo bhakolo bha Kiyahude bhakapahi jhe malelo ghahighalike panane pa nchalaba mulichiko lya Kupomolela, nhwalo Lichiko lya Kupomolela likibha lichiko likolongwa kwabhe. Akayahude bhajhakunyopa Pilatu makongono gha bhando bhubhabhambitwe imetulwanwe na malelo ghabhe ghanhuluhwe.

Bhahe, akakomana ngondo bhajhakujhenda, bhajhakung'onyolana makongono gha mundo jwalongolile kubhambwa na Yecho peniya bhajhakung'onyola magholo gha mundo jhuubhele bhubhakabhambitwe pamonga na Yecho panane jha panchalaba.
Nambo pubhanhikila Yecho, bhankolila ahwii njwe, bhakang'onywii jhe magholo ghake.
Nambo nkomana ngondo jhumo ajhakunyundukula Yecho nkowa gwa mu lubhaho, papalapala ijhakupita miyahe na mache.
Mundo jwalolita chenie chikipitila, ndi jwatulongolila na chalongila chakaka. Na chenie chaghalongila ndi chakaka, na mangota nnyeketele.
Itendika naha Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghabhehe telatela, “Kibhii jhe kihupa chake chikipalwa kumetulwa.”
Peniya Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge kabhele, “Nabhanolekeya mundo jhola jhubhanywundukwile nkowa.”
Yecho ighonechwa mumambe

Pughajhomokila gheniya, Uchupo jwa ku kilambo cha Alimataya, ajhakunyopa Pilatu yegha jha Yecho atole. Uchupo akibha mmolwa gwa Yecho jwa kukihiya hiya nhwalo abhajhogwipa bhakolo bha Akayahude. Pilatu ajhakunnobholela Uchupo ahuluwe yegha jha Yecho panane jha nchalaba, bhahe, Uchupo ajhakujhenda kuhuluwa yegha jha Yecho.
Uchupo akalongohine na Nikodemo, mundo jhola peniya makacho akanyendilila Yecho lichiko limo uhiko. Nikodemo akaletite piche nhwano jha ntela ghukemitwa manemane ghuhangalwine na ubane.
Bhahe, bhoha bhabhele bhajhakutola yegha jha Yecho bhajhakubhilingilila ngobho jha malelo pamonga na mahuta ngita chibhayobhalile Akayahude pakuchika.
Pala pubhamambita Yecho pakibha na kijhongo, mu kijhongo chenio pakibha na mambe yono, abhii jhe mundo jwakaghonikwe mwenio.
Nhwalo ikibha Lichiko lya Akayahude lya Kupomolela, na nhwalo mambe ikibha pahina, bhajhakubheka mwenio yegha jha Yecho.
